photos.desc: Anchiceratops , a ceratopsian dinosaur , closely related to Triceratops .
Two Anchiceratops facing off, with Ornithomimus in the foreground.
Anchiceratops was a ceratopsid, the family of horned planteating dinosaurs from late cretaceous America.
